t: Dairy Queen Is Giving Out Free Blizzards for 2 Weeks in Honor of Their Fall Menu
s: August 26, 2024 - In celebration of the seasonal menu’s arrival, Dairy Queen is offering a buy-one-get-one free deal from Sept. 9 to Sept. 22. Customers can buy one Blizzard and get another of “equal or lesser value,” per a release. For two weeks, DQ rewards members can snag the deal in the chain’s app and enjoy their Blizzards at participating locations.
